query: WITH input AS (SELECT hl.city, hl.district, w.wealth_level, COUNT(*) as count FROM estishraf_llm_wealth_index w JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON w.head_of_household_id = hl.id GROUP BY hl.city, hl.district, w.wealth_level) SELECT input.*, poly.wkt FROM input JOIN ESTISHRAF_LLM_KSA_Districts_Polygons poly ON input.district = poly.district AND input.city = poly.city
raw_question: اعرض لي خريطة لتوزيع مستويات الثروة جغرافياً لآخر 100000 سجل
